spec.objective: Base Wars overhaul — renewable contested resource economy + dead-world terrain. Full design spec: references/basewars-overhaul-spec.md. Replaces the AdLods LOD-mirroring approach with extractor-node taps, adds Liquid Fire fuel, Create output nerf, dead-tan surface grass, and contested below-Y0 lush caverns.
constraints: All children implement against references/basewars-overhaul-spec.md — that file is canonical.
Server-tunable values must be config-driven, not hardcoded.
Workload: nodecore (Forge 1.20.1). Switch a child to neoforge-mixin-v1 if it requires mixins.
acceptance_criteria: All nine children accepted through the validation gate
gradlew build passes for the nodecore workload
AdLods LOD-mirroring removed; extractor-node economy functional

spec.objective: Ore-node worldgen — indestructible permanent node fixtures generated in geographic metal-type CLUSTERS (copper region, iron region, etc.), with output TIERS (tier-3 out-produces tier-1). Replaces the AdLods finite-deposit generator. See spec §1.1, §6.
constraints: Nodes indestructible/unmovable; not strip-mineable
Metal types cluster by region, not uniform scatter
Frequency, spacing, cluster size, tier rates all config-driven
No dependencies — foundational child

spec.objective: Extractor multiblock — player-built drill attached to a node (ONE per node). Create rotational drive; fuel boost ladder charcoal<coal<lava<Liquid Fire (per-fuel boost config-driven); lava pipe-in for speed. Output buffer with BACKPRESSURE (full=pause). Power loss => pause + slow buffer decay. Raidable structure; node indestructible. See spec §1.2-§1.4.
constraints: Depends on child 1 (ore-node worldgen)
Drive = Create rotational power
Boost multipliers + consumption + buffer size + decay rate config-driven
Extractor destructible (raidable); node never destroyed
acceptance_criteria: Multiblock validates + pumps ore to buffer
Fuel ladder boosts production; lava pipeable
Backpressure pauses; power loss pauses + decays

spec.objective: No-build aura — config-radius no-block-placement zone around each node that WHITELISTS only the extractor's own multiblock parts. Keeps taps exposed (un-fortressable). See spec §1.5.
constraints: Depends on child 1 (node) and coordinates with child 2 (extractor whitelist)
Radius, enable toggle, and whitelisted-block set all config-driven
May require a placement-event mixin — switch to neoforge-mixin-v1 if so

spec.objective: Liquid Fire — custom Forge fluid + fluid block + bucket, top-tier fuel. Collection: cauldron under soul sand with lava on top fills slowly. Tint #00FBFF (soul-fire blue). Emit ParticleTypes.SOUL_FIRE_FLAME from the fluid block. Fuel burn time 32000-40000 ticks. See spec §4.
constraints: No dependencies
Cauldron-under-soulsand-with-lava-on-top collection mechanic
Registered as furnace/extractor fuel at the specified burn time
acceptance_criteria: Burn time 32000-40000; usable as extractor fuel

spec.objective: Create output nerf — keep Create grinding/washing/haunting recipes but SEVERELY reduce their metal/resource output, so they are the survivable baseline grind while extractor taps are the multiplier. See spec §1.6.
constraints: No dependencies
Reduce output, do not remove the recipes
Reduction factor config-driven where feasible

spec.objective: Surface dead-tan grass — global grass color/tint override so all surface grass renders uniformly dead-tan (no green islands on surface; green life is underground only). See spec §3.
constraints: No dependencies
Global grass-color provider / biome tint override
Likely client-side color provider; switch to neoforge-mixin-v1 if a mixin is needed

spec.objective: Growth-tick booster — DEPENDENCY-FIRST: locate any existing growth-tick-booster attempt in the NodeCore source, assess its state, then reuse/finish it or build it fresh. Accelerates plant/tree/crop growth inside lush caverns. Blocks child 8. See spec §5.
constraints: Start by searching the workload source for an existing attempt; report findings
Reuse/finish if present, build if not
Boost rate config-driven; blocks the lush-cavern child

spec.objective: Lush underground caverns — real worldgen, MASSIVE lush caverns ONLY below Y0, naturally generating surface flora underground (trees via Dynamic Trees, grass, ferns), big enough for tree/crop farms, with the growth-tick booster applied. Contested/raidable like ore taps. See spec §2.
constraints: Depends on child 7 (growth-tick booster)
Only spawn below Y 0
Dynamic Trees integration for trees; contested/raidable
Frequency/size config-driven
acceptance_criteria: Massive lush caverns generate below Y0
Trees/grass/ferns generate inside; growth booster active

spec.objective: AdLods teardown — remove the superseded AdLods sync + Large Ore Deposit LOD-mirroring system and its worldgen hooks, now replaced by extractor-node economy. See spec §6.
constraints: Remove AdLods bridge + LOD-mirroring worldgen hooks
Do not break the new ore-node worldgen (child 1)
Can run independently of other children
acceptance_criteria: No dangling references; gradlew build passes
